text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky has been training hard for
the Asahi
Hai F.S.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: So, what's up next for training?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Our goal is a G1 race, so wouldn't it be
good to
train a little harder?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hello, Maruzen!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I was watching you train! You're as
amazing as
ever!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I hope you don't mind, but I was
observing your
training as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
These bright young students still get
starry-eyed
when they talk to
Maruzensky.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Since transferring to the academy,
Special Week
has quickly become a
promising up-and-comer,
known for
both her skill and friendliness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And Grass Wonder may seem quiet at
first
glance, but her powerful running is
already
considered top-class.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Your stride was powerful and your
acceleration
was fluid, but above all
else...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: You looked like you were having a blast!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Heehee! Everyone's high expectations
are what
drive me to run my heart out!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Actually, Maruzensky, I have a favor to
ask you...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: You want to run with me, right?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wow! That's right! You know me too
well!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Your eyes are so sparkly, it's easy to tell.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
And, Grass, you may be quiet, but
you're also
bubbling with eagerness.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: W-well, yes... Hehe, sorry to impose.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, can I go run with these two for a
bit?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, can I go run with these two for a
bit?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I think racing with each of them in turn
would
make for a great training session.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Thanks! I'm off, then!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Spe, Grass, your elder has got a lot to teach you!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I'm already taking notes!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
All right! Let's get amped to the max,
homegirls!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Get... what?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: You heard her, Grass! Let's get amped!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Um... I was hoping to learn about running.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ahh, to be young again! Let's run into
the sunset
like the end of a
coming-of-age movie!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yes! Into the sunset, Grass!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: But the sun is still directly overhead...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I had so much fun training today!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I used to wonder if it was okay for me to
run, not
having a dream and all...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
But now, I love running ahead and
leading the
way for the cute younger
students! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to you, Trainer, for always
watching
over me. ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to you, Trainer, for always
watching
over me. ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, and I'll make sure you have lots of
fun in
return!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? What's that crowd over there? Is
something
groovy happening?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Are you saying that you intend to
become the top
Umamusume?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I am prepared to devote my heart
and soul
to leading all Umamusume
forward.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yoo-hoo, Rudolf! Are you doing an
interview?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Maruzensky. I was on my way back
to the
dorms, but then these reporters
showed up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf, the student council
president of
Tracen Academy, is one of
the stars of the
Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She is undefeated so far, and, like
Maruzensky,
attracting a lot of
attention.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I see you're as popular as always! But I'm
not
going to stand by and let you win! ♪

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
The Hot Rod and the Emperor... I can't
believe
we've caught these two highly
renowned racers
together like this!

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf, please tell us what you
think
about Maruzensky.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I believe she is going to help make the
Twinkle
Series very exciting.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I'm expecting big things from her.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'm just running for the fun of it, but I
can't help
feeling happy to hear that.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Do you think it's likely we'll eventually
see a
showdown between the two of
you?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...A showdown?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: It is not out of the question.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If we both push forward, our paths will
surely
cross. I have no doubt that the
day will come
when we run together.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: We're looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: No... I was just imagining it.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer, let's train a bit longer
today!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer, let's train a bit longer
today!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking of going for a drive, but
now I feel
like running. ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Come on, we don't want to interrupt the

interview. Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh... She feels like running all of a
sudden, does
she?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky's abilities and enjoyment are
only
increasing as she prepares for the
Asahi Hai F.S.
